messages:
maya (partnerships): Quick heads-up 1: VectorEdge wants to onboard apac-south-1b as a marketplace edge region for a pilot. Theyre asking for quota, a published SKU, and an approved pricing band by end of week. Can we triage?
rachel (vectoredge): We can commit 6 x H100e nodes at PoP. Target latency p95 < 70ms for 256-token median workloads. Need marketplace entitlement and billing SKU to run promo.
samir (cloud-partners): On marketplace: we need partner contact, entitlement JSON, sample billing SKU and region tag. We can approve up to 10 nodes without exec sign-off; >10 requires capacity committee.
vikas (infra): Ops notes: need VPC peering for private traffic, NAT config, and node healthchecks. Two asks: (1) will KV cache live in PoP or central region? (2) do we require failover to apac-east-1 or apac-north-1? Also need estimated qps and average seq len.
maya (partnerships): @rachel please post expected qps + seq len. We'll try to keep failover to apac-east-1.
rachel (vectoredge): Expect 2k qps steady, bursts up to 5k qps during regional events. Avg seq len 200 tokens. KV cache hit ~22% initially. We'll send a compact perf report tonight.
leah (legal): Marketplace listing will require partner addendum + confirmation of SOC2 posture. Do they accept our standard MSA? If not, SOW will delay onboarding ~10 business days.
rachel (vectoredge): We have SOC2 Type II and accept existing MSA terms. We will sign a short SOW for region-specific pricing.
samir (cloud-partners): I'll file a quota request: ticket #Q-2037-APACS1B. Need escalation emails and justification string.
maya (partnerships): Justification: "VectorEdge pilot to improve APAC latency, initial capacity 6 H100e nodes (2k qps), burst cap 5k qps. Marketplace promo planned; publishing required for billing tests"
ops-bot: Checklist created: marketplace/1860123456-vectoredge-apac-south-1b. Items: entitlement JSON, SKU created, quota approval, network peering, billing smoke test, legal addendum.
vikas (infra): Canary plan: route 5% traffic to PoP for 24 hours, then 25% for 72 hours if stable. Auto-fallback to apac-east-1. Need runbook for incident handoffs and postmortem template.
maya (partnerships): We'll require a billing smoke test (1k test tokens) and a dummy order before going live. Samir, can you coordinate billing test window?
samir (cloud-partners): Yep. I'll schedule a 30-min slot after quota approval. Also need partner billing contact.
rachel (vectoredge): Billing contact: finance@vectoredge.ai. We'll share payment test creds in the onboarding form.
leah (legal): I'll draft a short region SOW + addendum template and upload to Drive. ETA tomorrow morning.
vikas (infra): One ops caveat: with 200 token avg seq and H100 memory, 6 nodes look fine but caching will affect ram. If KV hit stays low, we may need +2 nodes for safety during bursts. Approve quota for 8 nodes to be safe?
maya (partnerships): Let's request 8 nodes in quota to avoid mid-pilot throttling. Rachel ok with that?
rachel (vectoredge): 8 nodes acceptable. We'll budget for that in pilot.
samir (cloud-partners): Quota filed: #Q-2037-APACS1B for 8 nodes. I added escalation contacts: maya@redwood.com, samir@redwood.com, rachel@vectoredge.ai.
ops-bot: Quota ticket created and linked: cloud-quota/Q-2037-APACS1B.
maya (partnerships): Action items: (1) Rachel: SOW + perf report (today). (2) Samir: follow quota + billing test. (3) Vikas: network peering and canary runbook. (4) Leah: region addendum. (5) Maya: publish checklist & SKU payload.
rachel (vectoredge): We'll send SOW and perf numbers by 1700 PT.
samir (cloud-partners): I'll wait on quota response and ping finance for billing test times.
vikas (infra): I'll open PR for canary routing and peering configs. Will flag any blockers in infra channel.
leah (legal): Draft in Drive: /legal/partner-addendums/vectoredge-apac-south-1b.
maya (partnerships): Cool. Tagging ops-leads for visibility: @ops-team FYI. If anything blocks, escalate to me directly. :raised_hands:
